claim: The accepted QST-SIM-0003 synthetic receiver-centered phase window makes line-of-sight an explicit gate while preserving the previous always-visible default; three of six declared sample phases are visible at the 0.25 visibility-fraction setting.

provenance.demonstrated_scale: one receiver-centered window and six orbital-phase samples
provenance.fact_summary: A 0.25 receiver visibility fraction marks three of six declared phases visible while default always-visible behavior remains available.
provenance.inference_summary: Receiver visibility can now gate future power-chain comparisons without silently assuming continuous host access.
provenance.speculation_summary: Coupling this gate to storage, eclipse, role mix, and relay-efficiency accounting may reveal when intermittent visibility changes coordinated-swarm value.
limitations: No real GEO ephemerides, Earth occlusion, antennas, storage, beam efficiency, or relay-performance claim.
